actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .mmClaw0000000000]] attacks and uses [[/item .mmBite0000000000]].

actions.name: claw
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from one of two claws.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=7mBlINHfcabm0DAr]], one creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=7mBlINHfcabm0DAr]] feet that is willing or that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

actions.name: deathless agility
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes the &Reference[Dash] or &Reference[Disengage] action.

actions.name: vampire weakness
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has these weaknesses: Forbiddance. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant. Running Water. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water. Stake to the Heart. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s heart while the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has the Incapacitated condition. Sunlight. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
